Container.Name: sapienheim-agent
Container.Overview: LLM brain for the Sapienheim Valheim companion. Talks to the ValheimCompanion mod over a private Docker network; holds the Claude API key and the companion's long-term memory.
Container.Requires: The Valheim server's mod config points at this machine's IP and the agent port (see deploy/README.md). Don't forward the port on your router.

Config.Name: Claude API key
Config.Description: From platform.claude.com. Never commit or share it.

Config.Name: Agent token
Config.Description: Shared secret; must match Agent.Token in the mod's server config.

Config.Name: Agent port
Config.Description: TCP port the mod connects to (Agent.Port in the mod config). LAN only: don't forward it on your router.

Config.Name: Memory / data
Config.Description: Long-term memory per world. Put a persona.md here to change its personality.

Config.Name: Dashboard (LAN only)
Config.Description: Status page. Map only on your LAN; never expose it to the internet.
